# Chewy
> Chewy is an online pet retailer and pet care platform offering pet food, supplies, pharmacy services, and expert educational content.

Chewy combines ecommerce for pet products with veterinary pharmacy, autoship subscriptions, and a large editorial library covering pet health, nutrition, behavior, breeds, and everyday care for dogs, cats, and other companion animals.

## Shop by Pet
- [Dog Supplies](https://www.chewy.com/b/dog-288): Shop dog food, treats, toys, beds, crates, and health products.
- [Cat Supplies](https://www.chewy.com/b/cat-325): Shop cat food, litter, furniture, toys, treats, and wellness essentials.
- [Fish Supplies](https://www.chewy.com/b/fish-1615): Browse aquariums, filters, fish food, water care, and tank accessories.
- [Bird Supplies](https://www.chewy.com/b/bird-939): Explore bird food, cages, toys, treats, and habitat accessories.
- [Small Pet Supplies](https://www.chewy.com/b/small-pet-940): Find food, habitats, bedding, chews, and accessories for small pets.
- [Reptile Supplies](https://www.chewy.com/b/reptile-963): Shop reptile food, terrariums, lighting, heating, and habitat décor.
- [Horse Supplies](https://www.chewy.com/b/horse-997): Browse horse feed, supplements, tack, grooming, and stable supplies.
- [Farm Animal Supplies](https://www.chewy.com/b/farm-animal-1579): Shop feed, treats, health products, and supplies for farm animals.

## Pharmacy & Health Services
- [Chewy Pharmacy](https://www.chewy.com/app/content/pharmacy): Online pet pharmacy for prescription medications, preventives, and health products.
- [Pet Medications](https://www.chewy.com/b/medications-treatments-1668): Browse prescription and over-the-counter medications and treatment categories.
- [Flea & Tick](https://www.chewy.com/b/flea-tick-2885): Shop flea and tick preventives, treatments, shampoos, and collars.
- [Heartworm](https://www.chewy.com/b/heartworm-2886): Find heartworm preventives and related parasite protection products.
- [Vitamins & Supplements](https://www.chewy.com/b/vitamins-supplements-1654): Explore supplements for joint, skin, digestive, and overall pet wellness.
- [Dental Care](https://www.chewy.com/b/dental-care-1661): Shop pet toothpaste, dental treats, water additives, and oral care tools.

## Autoship & Customer Services
- [Autoship](https://www.chewy.com/app/content/autoship): Learn how recurring deliveries work for food, litter, and pet essentials.
- [Manage Autoship](https://www.chewy.com/app/content/autoship#manage): Overview of updating schedules, quantities, and subscription items.
- [Shipping Policy](https://www.chewy.com/app/content/shipping): Details on shipping options, delivery timing, and order handling.
- [Returns Policy](https://www.chewy.com/app/content/returns): Information about returns, refunds, and satisfaction support.
- [Help Center](https://www.chewy.com/app/content/help): Customer support hub for orders, prescriptions, and account questions.
- [Contact Us](https://www.chewy.com/app/content/contact): Contact options for customer service and pharmacy-related assistance.

## Pet Health & Wellness Education
- [Chewy Education](https://www.chewy.com/education): Main editorial hub for pet care articles, guides, and expert advice.
- [Pet Health](https://www.chewy.com/education/category/health): Articles on symptoms, conditions, prevention, and veterinary care topics.
- [Pet Nutrition](https://www.chewy.com/education/category/food-and-nutrition): Guides to feeding, ingredients, diets, and nutritional needs by pet type.
- [Pet Behavior](https://www.chewy.com/education/category/training-and-behavior): Training and behavior resources for common pet challenges and routines.
- [Pet Lifestyle](https://www.chewy.com/education/category/lifestyle): Everyday care content covering routines, enrichment, travel, and home life.
- [Pet Safety](https://www.chewy.com/education/category/health-and-wellness): Wellness and safety guidance for prevention and healthy pet care habits.

## Dog Education
- [Dog Education](https://www.chewy.com/education/dog): Central hub for dog care, training, nutrition, and health content.
- [Dog Food & Nutrition](https://www.chewy.com/education/dog/food-and-nutrition): Feeding guides, ingredient explainers, and diet advice for dogs.
- [Dog Training & Behavior](https://www.chewy.com/education/dog/training-and-behavior): Training tips and behavior guidance for puppies and adult dogs.
- [Dog Health & Wellness](https://www.chewy.com/education/dog/health-and-wellness): Articles on preventive care, symptoms, and common canine health issues.
- [Dog Lifestyle](https://www.chewy.com/education/dog/lifestyle): Advice on grooming, exercise, travel, and daily life with dogs.
- [Dog Breeds](https://www.chewy.com/education/dog-breeds): Breed profiles with temperament, care needs, and physical characteristics.

## Cat Education
- [Cat Education](https://www.chewy.com/education/cat): Central hub for cat care, behavior, nutrition, and health resources.
- [Cat Food & Nutrition](https://www.chewy.com/education/cat/food-and-nutrition): Feeding advice, diet guides, and ingredient information for cats.
- [Cat Training & Behavior](https://www.chewy.com/education/cat/training-and-behavior): Guidance on litter habits, scratching, enrichment, and feline behavior.
- [Cat Health & Wellness](https://www.chewy.com/education/cat/health-and-wellness): Articles on symptoms, prevention, and common cat health concerns.
- [Cat Lifestyle](https://www.chewy.com/education/cat/lifestyle): Tips for grooming, home setup, play, and everyday cat care.
- [Cat Breeds](https://www.chewy.com/education/cat-breeds): Breed profiles covering personality, appearance, and care considerations.

## Other Pet Education

- [Small Pet Education](https://www.chewy.com/education/small-pet): Guides for rabbits, guinea pigs, hamsters, and other small pets.
- [Reptile Education](https://www.chewy.com/education/reptile): Articles on reptile habitats, feeding, heating, and husbandry basics.
- [Horse Education](https://www.chewy.com/education/horse): Horse care content covering feeding, grooming, tack, and wellness.
- [Farm Animal Education](https://www.chewy.com/education/farm-animal): Husbandry and care resources for backyard and farm animals.

## Breed & Species Guides
- [Dog Breeds](https://www.chewy.com/education/dog-breeds): Browse dog breed profiles with traits, size, and care summaries.
- [Cat Breeds](https://www.chewy.com/education/cat-breeds): Browse cat breed profiles with temperament and grooming information.

- [Senior Dog Care](https://www.chewy.com/education/dog/health-and-wellness/senior-dog-care): Guidance for aging dogs, mobility, nutrition, and wellness needs.
- [Senior Cat Care](https://www.chewy.com/education/cat/health-and-wellness/senior-cat-care): Advice for supporting older cats through changing health and lifestyle needs.
